test_title: PYST 12: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter-cluster that is different.
solution:
Table show alphabet serial number –

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/286550159bb1b1af83b0ffca14b226c7cea8abbacc574e15aefc51c80aadcc47.png] 

The logic is here,

**1st alphabet place value - 2nd alphabet place value = 3rd alphabet place value**

The pattern followed is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f462f037b41c6afbf276caba2cacf2bd0171ac3184f0450b8e3d0451b9908959.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23c49902613741d6fa2606ba18c1811a5ecb3a72f6740e3dbf3557b4c93c7e84.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ef44d6d3483268a70ded0a24f622dcf107e26ceab4d59e83c7a5eeeecce3774.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37910935fc71cb02d016beaa796586beeccb56e53f0a3346cbc70493aac75282.png] 

All follow the same pattern, except 'ZTG’.

Hence, “ZTG” is the odd one.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Table show alphabet serial number –

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/286550159bb1b1af83b0ffca14b226c7cea8abbacc574e15aefc51c80aadcc47.png] 

The logic is here,

2nd alphabet place value + 3rd alphabet place value = 1st alphabet place value

The pattern followed is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20863348bafbac5aa4f0c9ea8b7ffab7b066a6793f77af2b03940ba9017b882c.png] ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a30ef34f6c433769eaa4be60ff3a91e55a06454fb825cf50099ed573bb24da55.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/309ca1c0c36926fea1023f234f73e8e884f1590234971d47da51d4914b5b0a28.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37910935fc71cb02d016beaa796586beeccb56e53f0a3346cbc70493aac75282.png] 

All follow the same pattern, except 'ZTG’.

Hence, “ZTG” is the odd one.
